preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The size of each permutation n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation a must be a distinct integer from 0 to n-1.
The total sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of similar permutations modulo 10^9+7.
